availability.note: Chery AU E5 page: single grade 'Chery E5 Ultimate', postcode pricing live (Chery /api/dynamic-pricing/car-variant/3237 returns $39,604 for VIC 3000 and 3350); no Build & Price configurator exists on the Chery AU site. Nav lists 'New E5' (MY27 facelift, image 'MY27 E5 Side') as 'Coming soon' with no price; CarExpert 15 Sep 2026 says MY27 pricing and availability unconfirmed and it is a facelift of the same car (same motor and 430km claim)

listPrice.note: CarExpert 2026 Ultimate price page: 'prices starting at $35,990' before on-road costs (drive-away $37,990 Sydney). CarsGuide price page lists 2026 and 2027 E5 from $35,990 excluding stamp duty and government charges. Reconciled with Chery's own Victorian drive-away: Chery API $39,604 for VIC 3000; Chery footnote [E4] says it includes RRP, 12 months rego, CTP, DEALER DELIVERY and stamp duty. Plain back-out (39604-880)/1.042 = 37,163 round-trips to $39,603.85 via calc/onroad.js but overstates the list by the delivery charge (sources.md price rule 4). App drive-away at 35,990 = $38,381.58, so the implied delivery is ~$1,173 (+4.2% duty), a plausible dealer delivery charge. National default (no postcode) is $37,990, stated drive-away in Chery's 8 Apr 2026 release; prior list was $40,990 plus on-roads (CarExpert 29 Mar 2026, CarsGuide 8 Apr 2026). Current $2,000 cashback (1 Nov-21 Dec 2026) is a campaign and ignored.

batteryKwh.note: Chery AU MY26 spec sheet 'Battery Capacity (kWh) 58.9', 163.5Ah x 360.2V = 58.9 kWh, so this reads as the nominal pack energy of the mid-2025 replacement LFP pack. EV Database UK lists 58.9 usable / 60.9 nominal; CarExpert (29 Mar 2026) gives 61.1 gross / 58.9 usable. Usable vs gross unsettled; if 58.9 is nominal the usable figure is likely ~2 kWh lower.

rangeKm.note: Chery AU spec sheet 'All Electric Range - WLTP 430', 18-inch wheels 215/55 R18 (only wheel offered). AU sheet also quotes 505 NEDC (rejected by direction test). EV Database UK: 267 mi (430 km) WLTP for the UK Omoda E5, same 18-inch car.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 58.9 / 430 x 100 = 13.70. Published NEDC 132 Wh/km rejected (NEDC); EV Database WLTP rated 256 Wh/mi (15.9 kWh/100km) includes charging losses.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: AU spec sheet 'Luggage Capacity - VDA, Volume up to Cargo Cover 300' (matches convention). UK 380 L is a different measure.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: AU spec sheet 'Volume 2nd Row Seats Folded, up to Roof 1,079'. To the roof, not the belt line: no belt-line figure published (CarExpert July 2026 also gives 1,079 'measured to the roof'); reads high against the convention.

seats.note: schema.org seatingCapacity 5 on the Chery AU E5 page

towKg.note: CarExpert 2 Jul 2026 C5/E5 price and specs: 750kg braked. Chery AU spec sheet lists only 'Towing Capacity - Non-Braked Trailer 750' and 75kg towball; EV Database UK 750 braked / 750 unbraked.

warrantyYears.note: Chery AU spec sheet 'Vehicle Warranty 7 Years / Unlimited kms', battery 8 years / unlimited; no servicing condition stated on the sheet or the E5 page

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored to jaecoo-j5-ev-summit ($35,990, $1,500, same Chery group) and byd-atto3-essential ($39,990, $1,500); held $1,550 lowered to match the J5 EV at an identical list price

depreciationCurve.note: Chery brand convention used by every chery-tiggo-*-phev and jaecoo/omoda row (one convention per brand); held [..0.5,0.44,0.39] was the only Chery-group outlier. Below mainstream on evidence of heavy price cuts ($40,990 plus on-roads to $37,990 drive-away in Apr 2026, a further $2,000 cashback Nov 2026) and an imminent MY27 facelift.

lowConfidence: chery-e5-ultimate.listPrice: $35,990 RRP is from CarExpert/CarsGuide, not a Chery page; Chery publishes only drive-away (VIC $39,604 incl. dealer delivery). If Chery's delivery charge is lower than ~$1,173, the true list sits between $35,990 and $37,163
chery-e5-ultimate.batteryKwh: 58.9 may be nominal (163.5Ah x 360.2V) rather than usable; EV Database and CarExpert call it usable against a 60.9-61.1 kWh gross
chery-e5-ultimate.bootLitresSeatsDown: 1,079 L measured to the roof; no belt-line figure published
chery-e5-ultimate.towKg: braked 750 kg from CarExpert and EV Database UK; Chery AU spec sheet states only the 750 kg unbraked figure
